title: MCD2 is INVALID: a data stand-aside and a NO_MATCH
why: MCD2 has no usable reading (INVALID, too few bars) and MCD3, which reads it, is INVALID too. The Scalper's primary sensor is MCD2, so rule 0 stands it aside (INVALID, UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE:MCD2). The Day Trader's primary sensor, MCD1, is fine, but every row needs MCD2 or MCD3, so nothing matches: NEUTRAL, rule id NO_MATCH, recorded with every sensor's state (3.3 mechanic 5). This is how a gap in the table shows up in data.
